name_en: 2026 International Conference on Electronics Packaging and Hybrid Bonding Symposium (ICEP-HBS 2026)
venues: 広島国際会議場;グランドプリンスホテル広島
organizer: 一般社団法人エレクトロニクス実装学会 (JIEP)
notes: Hiroshima. 933 domestic, 258 overseas from 18 countries/regions (report). Joint with IEEE EPS Hybrid Bonding Symposium (Tue 4/14). Reception at Grand Prince Hotel Hiroshima per program and JA report (EN report says ICC Hiroshima). 49 exhibitors, 54 sponsors, 276 presentations. ICEP 2027 is called the 26th ICEP, so this may be the 25th (not stated).
